triggers: Leaving managed auth for Gmail means your own Google Cloud project must pass brand verification, restricted-scope verification and an annual CASA assessment before more than 100 users can connect (inferred from Google's rules; Composio's own verification status is not public to us).
Your users must see your app name on the Google consent screen; Google's verification checks that the consent screen shows the correct app name.
ownApp.notes: Composio lists Gmail as a Composio-managed OAuth toolkit, so stay on managed auth until you have a concrete reason to leave. If you do, start in Testing mode (100 test users, 7-day tokens) and pick the narrowest scope: gmail.send alone avoids restricted-scope verification and CASA. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard (Create Auth Config).

verdict.summary: Under an hour to a working test app; weeks to months to production for an agent that reads mail. gmail.readonly and gmail.modify are restricted scopes: verification plus an annual third-party CASA assessment. A send-only agent (gmail.send) scores 3: sensitive-scope verification, no CASA.

milestones.definition: Your project is in Testing mode and you, as a listed test user, can authorize Gmail scopes.
Up to 100 named test users outside your team can connect, behind a warning screen, re-consenting every 7 days.

limitsUntilNext.value: Testing mode is limited to 100 test users listed on the consent screen.

sources.quote: Projects configured with a publishing status of Testing are limited to up to 100 test users listed in the OAuth consent screen.

limitsUntilNext.value: Test-user authorizations, including refresh tokens, expire 7 days after consent.

sources.quote: Authorizations by a test user will expire seven days from the time of consent.

limitsUntilNext.value: B2B shortcut: a Google Workspace admin who marks your app Trusted lifts the 100-test-user cap and 7-day expiry for that organization.

sources.quote: This status overrides certain standard OAuth limitations for the organization's users, such as the 100-test-user cap and the 7-day refresh token expiration limit for apps in the Testing status.

milestones.definition: Any Google user can connect with no unverified-app screen and no user cap.

limitsUntilNext.value: Google says restricted-scope verification "can potentially take several weeks" and, elsewhere, "several months" depending on sensitivity. No upper bound is published. 14 days is our floor reading of "several weeks".

sources.quote: For this reason, the restricted scopes verification process can potentially take several weeks to complete.
Depending on the sensitivity of the data being requested, verification might require several months for the app to complete.

limitsUntilNext.value: Until verified, an app that shows the unverified-app screen is capped at 100 new users in total.

sources.quote: If your app remains unverified, the unverified app screen will be displayed before the consent screen, and your app will be limited to 100 new users until it is verified.

gates.name: Testing mode: 100 test users, 7-day refresh tokens

duration.value: Brand verification first: automated check usually a few minutes; manual review usually 2-3 business days. Scope review time beyond that is not published.

sources.quote: In some cases, where a result cannot be automatically determined, your app may undergo a manual review process that usually takes 2-3 business days .
For this reason, the restricted scopes verification process can potentially take several weeks to complete.

cost.value: Paid to the assessor. Vendor price lists suggest roughly $500–$3,000/yr for AL1 and $3,000–$9,000/yr for AL2.
cost.note: Vendor pricing via research.md §3.4; not re-fetched today. Google publishes no price.

recurring.value: Annual recertification; apps are assigned AL1 or AL2.

sources.quote: Annual Recertification: All applications must be revalidated every year.

requirements.label: Google Cloud project with the Gmail API enabled
requirements.detail: Google recommends separate projects for testing and production.

requirements.label: Verified domain, homepage and privacy policy
requirements.detail: The homepage must be on a verified domain you own (verified in Search Console by a project Owner or Editor) and describe the app.

requirements.label: Demo video
requirements.detail: Unlisted YouTube video showing the OAuth grant flow in English, the app name on the consent screen, and each scope in use.

requirements.label: CASA assessor (restricted scopes only)
requirements.detail: Contract an App Defense Alliance-authorized assessor once Google tells you to start.

scopes.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send
scopes.whyNeeded: Send email on the user's behalf.
scopes.justificationDraft: The agent sends emails the user drafts or approves; it never reads the mailbox.

scopes.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly
scopes.whyNeeded: Read messages to summarize or triage the inbox.
scopes.reviewTrigger: Restricted-scope verification plus annual CASA if data touches your servers.
scopes.justificationDraft: The agent reads new messages to produce a daily summary the user requested; narrower scopes can't return message bodies.

scopes.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify
scopes.whyNeeded: Read, label, archive and draft replies.

steps.title: Pick the narrowest Gmail scope
actions: If the agent only sends, request gmail.send only (sensitive, no CASA).
If it must read mail, budget for restricted-scope verification and CASA.
steps.doneWhen: Scope list and profile (send-only vs read/modify) are fixed.

steps.title: Create the project and OAuth client
actions: Create a project, enable the Gmail API.
Google Auth Platform → Branding (name, support email, logo, homepage, privacy policy, authorized domains).
Audience: External, Testing; add test users.
Clients → Web application, with the Composio redirect URI.
steps.doneWhen: A test user completes consent and you get a token.

steps.title: Brand and scope verification
actions: Verify the domain in Search Console.
Record the demo video and write per-scope justifications.
Submit in the Verification Center and answer Google's emails.

steps.title: CASA assessment (restricted scopes)
actions: When Google asks, engage an authorized assessor and complete the assessment.
steps.doneWhen: Letter of Validation submitted and app verified.

redirectUris.value: Adding redirect URLs or changing the product name after verification can trigger re-verification.

tokenLifetime.value: In Testing mode, refresh tokens expire 7 days after consent. Otherwise a refresh token stops working after 6 months unused, or on password change when it holds Gmail scopes.

sources.quote: The user changed passwords and the refresh token contains Gmail scopes.

refresh.value: Max 100 refresh tokens per Google Account per OAuth client; older ones are revoked past the limit.

sources.quote: There is currently a limit of 100 refresh tokens per Google Account per OAuth 2.

rateLimits.value: Unverified apps: 100 new users in total after the unverified-app screen is shown.

sources.quote: Apps that present the unverified app screen to users 100 new users in total, after the app presents the unverified app screen

blockers.description: Reading mail (gmail.readonly / gmail.modify) needs restricted-scope verification and a paid, annual third-party CASA assessment.
blockers.workaround: Ship a send-only agent first (gmail.send), or sell to Workspace orgs whose admins mark the app Trusted.

blockers.description: In Testing mode every test user's authorization expires after 7 days, so pilots silently disconnect weekly.
blockers.workaround: Build a re-consent prompt, or have the customer's Workspace admin mark the app Trusted.

blockers.description: Verification needs a homepage on a verified domain you own; a login page or unowned domain fails.
blockers.workaround: Publish a real homepage and privacy policy on your domain before submitting.

agentTasks: Classify requested scopes and recommend the narrowest set.
Draft scope justifications and the demo-video shot list.
Audit the homepage and privacy policy for the required disclosures.
Prepare CASA questionnaire answers and scanner evidence.
humanTasks: Contract and pay the CASA assessor; reply to Google Trust & Safety emails.

probes.observed: OIDC discovery: authorization_endpoint https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth, PKCE plain and S256.
Fake client rejected up front: authError decodes to "invalid_client: The OAuth client was not found."

unknowns: Actual end-to-end time for restricted-scope verification plus CASA: Google gives "several weeks" to "several months", no upper bound.
CASA price: only vendor price lists (secondary); Google publishes none.
Whether Composio's managed Gmail app is verified for restricted scopes (not public to us).
Sensitive-only (gmail.send) review duration beyond brand verification: not published.

evidence.claim: Testing mode: up to 100 test users; authorizations expire after 7 days.
evidence.quote: Authorizations by a test user will expire seven days from the time of consent.

evidence.claim: gmail.send is sensitive; gmail.readonly and gmail.modify are restricted.
evidence.quote: Restricted scopes Scope code Description https://mail.google.com/ Read, compose, send, and permanently delete all your email from Gmail.

evidence.claim: Restricted-scope apps need an annual security assessment (CASA, AL1 or AL2).
evidence.quote: To maintain the security of Google users' data, applications requesting access to restricted scopes must undergo an annual security assessment.

evidence.claim: Restricted-scope verification can take several weeks.
evidence.quote: For this reason, the restricted scopes verification process can potentially take several weeks to complete.

evidence.claim: Brand verification: automated in minutes, manual review usually 2-3 business days.
evidence.quote: The automated brand verification process typically takes a few minutes after you click the Verify Branding button.

evidence.claim: The homepage must be on a verified domain you own.
evidence.quote: The homepage must be hosted on a verified domain you own

evidence.claim: The demo video is uploaded to YouTube as Unlisted.
evidence.quote: Upload the video to YouTube Studio and set Visibility as Unlisted .

evidence.claim: A Workspace admin marking the app Trusted lifts the test-user cap and 7-day expiry for that org.
evidence.quote: When a Google Workspace administrator marks an app as Trusted , it is treated as an internal application for that organization.

evidence.claim: CASA AL1 roughly $500–$3,000/yr; AL2 roughly $3,000–$9,000/yr (vendor prices).
Fake client_id is rejected with invalid_client at the authorize endpoint.

corrections.after: Assurance levels AL1 / AL2, assigned by Google; annual revalidation.
